release_notes_md:
## What's new

**A redesigned, customizable dashboard.** Your home screen now leads with your camera data. Build the view you want: add and arrange widgets from a gallery, save multiple layouts, and switch between them. On first run after adding a camera, a layout picker offers 12 ready-made templates (including a General template for any setup) to get you started in one click.

**Guided onboarding that understands your space.** Enrollment now captures each camera's role (entrance, interior, overview, perimeter, parking) and suggests one automatically from the camera itself. A new "General" role group lets you set up meaningful zones and metrics even when none of the industry presets fit.

**Sharper reporting.** Analytics queries can now filter by camera role and accept a custom start/end date range, so you can slice your data exactly how you need it.

**System Health has its own page.** Infrastructure and service status moved off the main dashboard into a dedicated System Health view, keeping your home screen focused on what your cameras are seeing.

**Tile drill-down everywhere.** Click any dashboard widget to open the detailed breakdown and export it to CSV — the same drill-down that was previously limited to preset pages.

## Upgrade notes

- No manual steps. The update applies a small database change automatically on first start (adds the saved-dashboards table; removes two unused legacy tables).
- The old `/presets` pages now redirect to the new dashboard. Your existing data and zones are unchanged.
